newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower in moderate trade.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Friday after early hopes of a continuation on Thursday's rally were dashed.
"People thought the futures were going to go one stg up, but in the end nothing came of it," said a trader.
Traders said the early rise in was soon sold into and by the close profit-taking had pushed wheat to 0.95 to 0.25 stg down on the day after trading 473 lots.
"Prices went up and suddenly there were sellers everywhere," said another trader.
November wheat expired at the end of the morning session after trading at 95.75 stg unchanged from Thursday.
Barley finished 0.20 stg down to 0.30 stg up after trading 150 lots, however 102 of these were switches from November, which expired at the end of the morning session, into January.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
Trading in physical grain was slow although feed wheat fetched 102.50 stg for Feb on the fob market while 104 stg was paid for Apr/Jun ex-east coast ports.
Traders reported only light trading on the delivered market.
